frozen_before: any model in this study was fitted or scored; engine and metric set fixed by the NFL study
market_family: NHL full-game lines: winner (incl. OT/SO), goal difference, total goals; regular season
prediction_cutoff: scheduled puck drop (cutoff_utc); every feature uses games strictly before the game date
labels: final score incl. overtime/shootout from the certified dataset. The dataset ends with the 2025-26 regular season; the vault's Kalshi official NHL results cover contracts closing 2026-09-20..2026-11-15 (2026-27 season), so no contract-level official-label scoring is possible until the dataset is extended
baseline: record_strength = walk-forward ridge on certified standings-rate inputs (points per game, regulation win rates); climatology = expanding mean
